derivation: perhaps feminine of H68 (אֶבֶן); stony;  Compare H549 (אֲמָנָה).

occurrences.text: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
